content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can deploy a fully functional online store in under 48 hours, utilizing tools that give you complete ownership and control. With COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit, you gain immediate access to comprehensive blueprints and templates that are designed for ease of use. Start by selecting the digital products you want to sell—whether it’s eBooks, courses, or software—and outline your offerings. The infrastructure is laid out for you: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. You don’t need to navigate a complex setup; everything is documented and ready for action, ensuring you can begin selling without delays.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The most effective stack for Kenyan creators involves combining Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This stack is not only free to use but also scalable, allowing you to grow your business without the burden of traditional payment fees. By utilizing this infrastructure, you eliminate costly transaction fees and gain the ability to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This is critical for creators who face currency instability within their local markets. With only a few configurations required, you can establish a store that is fully operational, meets your specific needs, and gives you full data ownership.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Too often, creators become bogged down with unnecessary planning and features that do not contribute to immediate revenue generation. Focus on the essentials: a functional store, a clear product offering, and a reliable payment system. Skip considerations like advanced marketing strategies or extensive inventory management until your store is live and generating income. This approach allows you to learn from real customers and sales data, refining your offerings based on actual market feedback. Concentrate on executing the core elements of your business model; the additional features can be integrated later as your operations evolve. Your priority should be building a functional commerce system quickly and efficiently.
Get your business online within 48 hours without traditional payment barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your store is set up, it's time to test the system with a live transaction. This step is crucial for ensuring everything operates smoothly from product selection to payment confirmation. Use NOWPayments to process a nominal fee for one of your digital products; this will validate your payment flow and provide critical insights into order processing. Check that customers can easily navigate your store, complete their purchases, and receive products instantly. If any issues arise, use the immediate feedback to make adjustments. The goal is to establish a seamless experience for your customers, as this will set the foundation for future sales and reinforce your credibility in the market.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Within the next 24 hours, focus on marketing your newly established store. Utilize social media platforms and relevant online communities to share your products and attract initial customers. Create engaging content that highlights the unique aspects of what you are offering. Promote the benefits of purchasing directly from you, emphasizing the security and convenience of crypto payments through NOWPayments. Additionally, consider gathering feedback from your first buyers to enhance your offerings and customer experience. The urgency of these actions will help you capitalize on the momentum of your launch, establishing your presence in the digital marketplace without delay.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit for access to the necessary resources. 2. Choose a digital product you wish to sell and prepare it for delivery. 3. Set up hosting using either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Implement the backend logic with Google Apps Script to manage orders. 5. Configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, linking your wallet. 6. Test your payment flow with a nominal transaction. 7. Share your new online store with your audience through social media. 8. Gather feedback on the buying experience and make necessary adjustments to improve.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Complete Builder Kit?

The Complete Builder Kit is a comprehensive package that includes all the blueprints and templates needed to set up your own online store. It enables creators to quickly start selling digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How does NOWPayments work?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%. There’s no need for buyer accounts, and the system processes payments automatically once they confirm on-chain.
Can I use this system in countries where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable?
Yes, this infrastructure is explicitly designed for creators in regions with restrictions on traditional payment platforms. It allows you to reclaim your financial sovereignty.
What types of digital products can I sell?
You can sell a wide range of digital products, including eBooks, courses, software, and templates. The framework supports various types of digital content.
Is there ongoing support after setup?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes access to 30 days of support to assist you with initial setup and troubleshooting as you establish your store.
